title: Relocate Marbles
summary: Given an array of initial marble positions, perform a series of moves where each move relocates all marbles from one position to another.
statement: Given an array of initial marble positions, perform a series of moves where each move relocates all marbles from one position to another. After all moves, return a sorted list of positions that contain at least one marble.
constraints: A marble exists at every distinct position in nums.
For each operation, move every marble at moveFrom[i] to moveTo[i]; the source is guaranteed occupied.
Return the distinct occupied positions in increasing order.
hints: A set models distinct occupied positions and naturally merges moves onto occupied destinations.
For each move, remove its source and add its destination.
Each operation changes exactly those two occupancy facts, so induction matches the marble configuration after every move.
editorial: Each operation changes exactly those two occupancy facts, so induction matches the marble configuration after every move.

tests.explanation: Moves produce occupied positions five, six, eight, and nine.
Moving onto an occupied position merges occupancy, leaving only position two.
